query: Can you take a look at this email before I send it to Marcus?
expected_behavior: Recognises this is a decision document with the recommendation buried at the end
Does NOT return a rewritten version of the email
Offers the restructure in roughly one line, naming the specific symptom, then stops and waits

query: Use the minto-pyramid skill on this draft.
expected_behavior: Applies immediately without asking permission first
Recommendation appears in the first sentence or two
Risks (six weeks dual running, 24-month minimum) survive in their own section
No number, name or claim appears that is not in the source

query: Write up my recommendation to leadership from these notes. Notes: evaluated 3 log vendors. Datadog renewal is $91k/yr, up 40%. Grafana Cloud quoted $52k but migration is ~3 sprints of platform time. Staying put means the 40% increase and we lose the volume discount tier next year anyway. Two engineers already know Grafana. Retention needs to stay at 30 days for the SOC2 audit and both options do that.
expected_behavior: Writes the document directly rather than offering first, since the user asked for it to be written
Opens with the recommendation, not with background on the evaluation
Groups the supporting reasons rather than narrating the vendor comparison
Does not invent figures beyond those given

query: Can you clean this up for the postmortem doc?
expected_behavior: Does NOT restructure into conclusion-first order
States in about a line that chronology is the right order for an incident timeline
Either proceeds with an ordinary tidy-up or asks what kind of cleanup is wanted
